prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. A rainy evening in a 1930s marble bank, close on a thin young white clerk with centre-parted oiled hair and sleeve garters at a loan desk, his real-skinned face large in frame and off-centre right: bored, half-lidded eyes, a shaving nick on his chin, chewing gum. He holds a heavy wooden rubber stamp raised up by his ear, its face blank and wet with red ink. The dark brown shoulder of a heavy-set Black man in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a double chin, in a shabby brown suit two sizes too small fills the near foreground on the left, out of focus. A green-shaded banker's lamp lights the clerk from below; behind him, soft, the huge round vault door glows warm gold, and a tall rain-streaked window glows cold blue. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the lamp on his face and the gold vault. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
